about_the_game:
A unique blend of gameplay not quite seen before has fans saying it is, "Re-Defining A Genre."

After letting his girlfriend down for the last time, Billy is swiftly dumped on his two-year anniversary. While walking home alone in the rain, a mysterious portal swallows him up and spits him out on a distant alien world.

Where are you? How did you get here? And why is there a space llama yelling at you? From here, it is up to you to choose how you get these answers and find your way home.

Oh, and save the world, too.

Billy Saves the World gives players ultimate freedom. You can head straight to the end for a more challenging experience, or you can explore the 2D open-world to find abilities and upgrades that will help you on your journey.

Every side-quest you discover, every optional level you find, every creature you speak to, leads to unique moments with multiple outcomes, solutions, and gameplay approaches.

  • Featuring one of the year's best soundtracks, composed by John McMillan (Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag) and multi-platinum producer Tom Ratesic (Nicki Minaj, Lil Wayne). And audio by Jonathan Beres (Game of Thrones).

  • Run, Slide, Jump, Rocket-Boost, Wall-Jump, and use Jedi-like super powers to explore a small but dense 2D metroidvania-style open world, featuring 7+ diverse biomes with beautifully hand drawn environments and animation from top film & tv professionals.

  • Solve over 25 side-quests with multiple dialogue branches, solutions and outcomes based on what you say and do.

  • Packed with 30+ optional levels to discover and explore, each containing different routes, unique enemies, deadly traps, creative puzzles, secret collectibles, and nail biting time trials.

  • Optional upgrades including 6 Heart Pieces (each with unique benefits) and over 7 special abilities to acquire.

Join the official Discord channel for the latest news & announcements, chat directly with the creator, PLUS receive exclusive videos, images, WIPs and more.

short_description: Seamlessly choose between action-platforming and explorative puzzle-solving in this narrative-driven platformer. You play as a boy with a broken heart in an epic sci-fi love story about becoming a better half for your other half.
